setting amount num 1000.. = 500000 "Loan amount"
setting rate num 0..60 = 12 "Interest per year (%)"
setting months num 1..360 = 24
field amount
field rate
field months

stat round(emi), "per month"

state mode pick Km_to_miles|Kg_to_pounds|C_to_F = Km_to_miles
field v "Value"
choice mode
let out = if(mode = Km_to_miles, v * 0.621, if(mode = Kg_to_pounds, v * 2.205, v * 9 / 5 + 32))
stat fixed(out, 2), "result"

request: bill splitter: total bill, number of people, tip with a slider up to 30 percent, shows what each person pays
program:
app "Split" calc mint
state bill num = 0
state people num = 2
state tip num = 10
field bill "Bill"
field people "People"
slider tip 0..30
"Tip" tip "%" faint
stat fixed(bill * (1 + tip / 100) / people, 2), "each person pays"
